create_timestamp_from_centiseconds: create a Timestamp from centiseconds using the from_centis class method
create_timestamp_from_seconds: create a Timestamp from seconds using the from_seconds class method
get_current_timestamp: get the current UTC timestamp as a Timestamp using the now class method
convert_timestamp_to_seconds: convert a Timestamp to seconds as a float or int using to_seconds_float or to_seconds_int
add_subtract_timestamps: add or subtract two Timestamp instances using the __add__ and __sub__ operators
